what_they_do: WiseBee is a cybersecurity platform that pulls findings from vulnerability scanners, cloud posture tools, external attack surface monitoring, and third-party vendor risk feeds into a single triage queue. It uses AI to score which findings are actually exploitable, prepares fixes for engineers, automatically rescans to confirm the fix worked, and produces audit-ready documentation. This replaces the manual process where security teams review thousands of disconnected alerts across separate tools each week and keep spreadsheets to prove compliance.
theme_fit_rationale: WiseBee consolidates several fragmented, siloed security tools (scanners, cloud posture, attack surface, vendor risk) into one automated triage-to-remediation workflow, directly matching Theme 2's compliance-and-verification use case and its thesis of agents displacing manual labor by reading/writing across systems.

recent_signals.summary: WiseBee announced a partnership with Wiser Technology (AI-driven enterprise operations/workflow automation) to combine operational and cyber risk intelligence for compliance with DORA and NIS2.
Founder/CEO Stoyan Stoyanov was featured on the Execweb Cybersecurity GTM Podcast discussing prioritization in security operations.
